lines: •Narrowing 2026 non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance to upper half of $2.02-$2.07 range
•Extending base plan expected non-GAAP adjusted EPS annual growth guidance of 6%-8% to 2027-2033
NiSource is narrowing its 2026 non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance to the upper half of $2.02-$2.07.
In 2027, non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.22-$2.30.
The company’s base plan non-GAAP adjusted EPS growth is expected to be 6%-8% annually with 8%-10% rate base growth expected from 2027-2033.
